# TPC-DS-OBT Q3 — obt_returns_summary

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

Summarize returned sales and amount

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  sold_date_d_year,
  item_i_brand_id AS brand_id,
  item_i_brand AS brand,
  SUM(ext_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk
    AND obt.item_sk = item_i_item_sk
    AND item_i_manufact_id = 1
    AND sold_date_d_moy = 11
  )
  AND channel = 'store'
GROUP BY
  sold_date_d_year,
  item_i_brand,
  item_i_brand_id
ORDER BY
  sold_date_d_year,
  sum_agg DESC,
  brand_id
LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q3_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    table = ctx.get_table("tpcds_sales_returns_obt")
    return table.filter(ctx.col("has_return") == ctx.lit("Y")).select(
        ctx.col("sale_id").count().alias("returned_sales"),
        ctx.col("return_amount").sum().alias("total_return_amount"),
    )
```
